lines: Aldo: Good. A cartographer shouldn't walk the valley alone.
Aldo: Every Rift that opens spreads the Hush. Spirlings near it go quiet and forget their Wayfarers.
Aldo: The last time the sky split like this, you weren't born yet. Your grandmother Mirela went in to map that Rift. She never came back.
Aldo: Her map book was up in the lamp room. The storm tore it apart and blew the pages across the valley.
Aldo: The cartographers will need fresh maps. Take this, and go see Kestra at the map house.
Aldo: And {name}... if you find any of Mirela's pages out there, bring them home.
Aldo: The lamp stays lit for you. If your team is worn out, the Rest Spring is just up the pier.

stairs: The spiral stairs lead up to the lamp room.
Aldo keeps it lit every night.

lines: Aldo: {name}! You're awake at last.
Aldo: Three little Spirlings came in from the storm last night. They followed the lamp across the lake.
Aldo: They're still huddled by the lamp stairs. One of them keeps looking at you.
Aldo: Go on. Kneel down and say hello.
Aldo: Kestra thinks something lives behind the Rifts?
Aldo: ...Mirela wrote the same thing, the night before she left.
Aldo: There's a third Rift north of the crest. If Mirela is anywhere, she's there.
Aldo: The ferry will run again one day. Until then, make your team strong. And find her pages.
Aldo: The lamp stays lit. It always has, for her. Now for you too.
You climb the spiral stairs to the lamp room. Aldo follows, slowly.
You lay Mirela's six pages under the great lamp. The light shines through the paper...
...and the lines join up. It's one map: the lake, the terraces, and a path north past Crowcrest.
At its end, in Mirela's hand: 'Where the map ends, I wait. Keep the lamp lit.'
Aldo: Forty years I kept this lamp burning, and never knew why she asked me to.
Aldo: She's out there, {name}. Past the third Rift. Take this. It was hers.
Marla: I'm Marla. I trade goods for Waymarks, the stones Wayfarers earn on the road.
Marla: Coins won't do here, and nobody can buy Waymarks. You earn them, you spend them.
Marla: Waymarks in hand? Let's see what's in the crates this week.
